allowed_dir = Path("configs").resolve()

Used pathlib.Path.resolve() to canonicalize paths and detect attempts to escape the allowed directory using '..' or symbolic links. Validates that resolved path stays within allowed_dir.

from urllib.parse import urlparse
parsed = urlparse(url)
if parsed.hostname in ("localhost", "127.0.0.1", "0.0.0.0"):
    logger.warning(f"Blocked local URL: {url}")
    return None
if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https"):
    logger.warning(f"Invalid URL scheme: {parsed.scheme}")
    return None
resp = requests.post(url, json={...}, timeout=5)
details.fix_explanation: Added SSRF protections: (1) URL parsing and validation to ensure only HTTP/HTTPS, (2) Blocked access to internal IPs (localhost, 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0), (3) Added timeout to prevent hanging requests. This prevents attackers from using the app to make requests to internal services or cloud metadata endpoints.

Replaced MD5 with SHA256. MD5 is cryptographically broken and should not be used for password hashing or authentication. SHA256 is more secure and FIPS-compliant. For production, use dedicated password hashing libraries like bcrypt or argon2.

Disabled debug mode by default. Debug mode exposes sensitive information (error traces, source code, interactive debugger). Now reads FLASK_ENV variable to enable debug only in development. Use environment-based configuration instead of hardcoded debug=True.
